references.text: Wash the clothes and be unclean until evening - same principle for cleansing of clothes due to uncleanness
On the seventh day he shall wash his clothes - same timeframe for the cleansing process
He shall wash his clothes and bathe in running water, then he is clean - combination of washing clothes and cleansing
On the seventh day he shall cleanse himself, wash his clothes and bathe in water - same cleansing ritual on the seventh day
The one who has killed someone or touched a dead body shall cleanse themselves on the third and seventh days - context for this cleansing
After the cleansing ritual they shall wash their clothes and then enter the camp - same pattern of washing and then gaining access to the camp
